new_all_degree_arguments: For every normal unirational constant-unit algebra with compact conjugation,algebraic dependence of a and a_dagger is equivalent to a=p(h) with a regular self-adjoint real seed h. Normalization of the image curve gives A1,and its real form is affine-linear.

On a generically totally real compact core,the alternative is real differential rank2 somewhere,and hence image with interior. The rank1 case has a finite polynomial-path image graph and positive smooth open-edge densities away from finitely many critical values.

For a positive finite graph measure with connected complement,the interval-moment Cauchy germ has rational derivative-1/(s2-1) everywhere off the graph. Residue quantization and the local Cauchy jump force all edges horizontal with constant half-integer density;the derivative then forces exactly Uniform[-1,1].
For the pure-moment germ1/s,the derivative has zero residues,so every graph edge has zero mass and the measure is delta0.

A flat exceptional height with nonseparating symmetrized graph would therefore be real with bounded positive density,contradicting noncyclic sphere symmetry. All complex line-valued heights are excluded in every degree.

Every remaining flat height has image interior or is a polynomial of a real seed whose SYMMETRIZED image graph separates the plane. For a nonzero pure phase on the FULL original quotient,the corresponding graph condition uses its UNSYMMETRIZED image.

The separating polynomial path t2-1+i*t is an exact geometry boundary example only. Both actual canonical source heights have nonzero D/E compact-conjugate brackets and hence rank2,without restoring their rejected purity.
